exposure: development evidence: consulted during the M04 remediation; not an unseen holdout; variants share families and are not independent samples

non_pass.detail: mid-clause punctuation name followed by a word after a transitive verb: surface-identical to the supported command position ('hello comma how are you' LF-SYN-025, 'cat notes dot txt pipe grep today' LF-SYN-035). Deciding that the next word is a compound-noun head needs part-of-speech knowledge a deterministic grammar does not have (design D2); the clause-start, determiner and lexical guards cover the other variants of this family. Escape: 'write the word period'.

utterance-final 'period' after a noun: surface-identical to the accepted positive 'stop period' → 'stop.' (LF-SYN-026, SC corpus). The curated 'X period' compound list (grace/trial/notice/…) stays, but adding each new noun is the blacklist growth the audit rejects (design D2). Escape: 'write the word period'.

utterance-initial 'slash <exact registered alias>' is the accepted command form ('slash brainstorm' → '/brainstorm', LF-SYN-015 / SC-01). With 'costs' registered as a skill, 'slash costs' is surface-identical; the repair removes the verb-context readings (REGISTRY-03/-05 now literal) but cannot infer intent here without lexical semantics (design D2).
